body_md:
## CBSE Class 10 Result 2026

The CBSE has declared the Class 10 board exam results. Students can check their results on the official website.

### How to Check

1. Visit cbseresults.nic.in
2. Click on 'CBSE Class 10 Result 2026'
3. Enter roll number, school number, and center number
4. Submit and view result
5. Download and print
